rules.condition: is this bot's current health below 25% of its maximum health?
rules.criteria_true: health is less than one quarter of max health
rules.criteria_false: health is greater than or equal to one quarter of max health

rules.condition: is there a visible enemy inside melee range of this bot?
rules.criteria_true: an enemy is within melee distance
rules.criteria_false: no enemy is within melee distance

rules.condition: is there no immediate threat requiring retreat or engagement?
rules.criteria_true: no enemy is in melee range and 'chord' is not ready
rules.criteria_false: an enemy is in melee range or 'chord' is ready

validation_notes: priority guard: promoted rule(s) recall_low_hp to the top of the cascade -- the prose uses unconditional-override language for them (no exceptions) but the translator placed them lower, where an earlier rule could pre-empt them.
